title: The sealed kit on the medical coat
body: The kit's seal is unbroken. A bandage has been folded around its handle, still clean, with a patient wrist label tied through the fold and no name on it.
rival_reading: A sealed kit could have been carried away from an exposure site before anyone opened it; an unnamed label does not establish a failed transfer.
gloss: A clean bandage and sealed kit remain with an erased identity.

title: The bottle with a leaf-shaped tide
body: A brown tide line circles the bottle; the notebook beside it has one page stuck to the cap. When it lifts, a pressed leaf outline remains on the paper.
rival_reading: A responder could collect water and leaves while checking an evacuation route; the residue could be ordinary field dirt.
gloss: A water mark and plant trace were collected together.
